operations.before: Under the hypotheses of [[lem-canonical-kick-and-drift-shears-have-symplectic-jacobians]], every admitted local leapfrog step and every admitted kick-then-drift symplectic Euler step has a $C^1$ Jacobian satisfying $D\Phi^TJD\Phi=J$ on its open admitted domain. The result concerns symplecticity, not energy conservation.
operations.proposed: Under the hypotheses of [[lem-canonical-kick-and-drift-shears-have-symplectic-jacobians]], every admitted local leapfrog step and every admitted kick-then-drift symplectic Euler step is a $C^1$ map with a continuous Jacobian satisfying $D\Phi^TJD\Phi=J$ on its open admitted domain. The result concerns symplecticity, not energy conservation.
